messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: You should not take gabapentin if you are allergic to it.
To make sure this medicine is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- breathing problems
- diabetes
- depression, a mood disorder, or suicidal thoughts or actions
- a history of alcohol use or drug addiction
- a seizure
- (for patients with restless legs syndrome) if you are a day sleeper or work a night shift
- kidney disease, or if you are on dialysis
Some people have thoughts about suicide while taking seizure medicine. Children taking gabapentin may have behavior changes. Stay alert to changes in your mood or symptoms. Your family or caregivers should also watch for sudden changes in your behavior.
Pregnancy:
It is not known if gabapentin will harm an unborn baby. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. Do not start or stop seizure medication during pregnancy without your doctor's advice, because having a seizure during pregnancy could harm both mother and baby. If you are pregnant, your name may be listed on a pregnancy registry to track the effects of gabapentin on the baby.
Breastfeeding:
Ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using gabapentin.
Triples: [["gabapentin", "contraindicated in", "allergy to gabapentin"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "breathing problems"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "diabetes"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "depression"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "mood disorder"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "suicidal thoughts or actions"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "alcohol use disorder"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "drug addiction"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "seizure history"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "restless legs syndrome with day sleeping"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "restless legs syndrome with night shift"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "kidney disease"], ["gabapentin", "use with caution in", "dialysis"], ["gabapentin", "has risk of", "suicidal thoughts"], ["gabapentin", "has side effect in children", "behavior changes"], ["gabapentin", "has warning", "may harm unborn baby during pregnancy"], ["gabapentin", "requires pregnancy consultation", "pregnancy"], ["gabapentin", "requires doctor advice before starting or stopping", "seizure medication during pregnancy"], ["gabapentin", "has pregnancy registry involvement", "unborn baby"], ["gabapentin", "has breastfeeding consideration", "breastfeeding"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "has breastfeeding consideration", "has pregnancy registry involvement", "has risk of", "has side effect in children", "has warning", "requires doctor advice before starting or stopping", "requires pregnancy consultation", "use with caution in"]
Answer:

completion:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.  
use with caution in: The subject drug may pose safety risks or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.  
has risk of: The subject drug may lead to the adverse event or condition specified by the object entity.  
has side effect in children: The subject drug may cause the specified behavioral change in children who take it.  
has warning: The subject drug may pose a risk to the specified entity, and patients should be informed of this potential harm.  
requires doctor advice before starting or stopping: Patients should consult a doctor before initiating or discontinuing the use of the subject drug in the specified context.  
requires pregnancy consultation: Patients who are pregnant or planning pregnancy should consult a doctor regarding the use of the subject drug.  
has breastfeeding consideration: Patients should consult a doctor to determine if it is safe to breastfeed while using the subject drug.
